## What it is

A Doodle Jump clone — fully self-contained HTML file (HTML + inline CSS + inline `<script>`). Open in any browser; no build, no dependencies.

## Style / approach

- Cream/parchment palette (`#f4ead5` background, `#f8f0dc` canvas) with Comic Sans / Marker Felt typography — leans into the original Doodle Jump aesthetic.
- Pixelated rendering (`image-rendering: pixelated`).
- Overlay UI with rounded card, yellow text-shadow on `h1`, dark border — most polished of the three variants visually.
- Mobile-aware: `apple-mobile-web-app-capable`, `user-scalable=no`, `touch-action: none`.

## How to run

```bash
open games/doodle-jump_claude-opus-4-7.html
```

## When to use as reference

Pick this variant when you want the most opinionated UI styling (overlays, shadows, typography). For raw mechanics comparison, see the gemini-cli and tour-agent-maker variants alongside it.
